figma.note: layers renamed to m-* roles 2026-10-14 (names only, geometry unchanged, ADR 0036); 9 m-impulse: horizontal bars on dotted lines run; the vertical streak Rectangle 3717 stays as drawn; the main component Illustration is a library component, so the shadow is renamed inside the instance (m-card)

export.how: Figma export SVG with 'Include id attribute', sent by the team; then colours replaced by the nearest existing tokens (option B, as in Ticketing, Schedule Changes and Virtual Payments, applied by precedent 2026-10-14): #003747 and #034152 -> #013746, #03637C -> #044F64, #33CAAF -> #2ABDA3, #9BF4DE -> #8CF9E5, shadow matrix #01212a -> #032e39. Figma itself was not changed. The 3 embedded noise PNGs re-encoded losslessly as indexed PNGs (same pixels, 1.31 MB -> 0.57 MB). Then the wallet body (Rectangle 3712 base excluded: only the body Rectangle 3714 and the strip Rectangle 3713) made #044F64 instead of #013746 (token illustration.avatar.circle-start, as the cards in Schedule Changes and Virtual Payments): at #013746 the body merged with the page background #022E3A. The clasp hole stays #013746. Original: source/figma-export.raw.svg.
